answer: canyon keeps one audited active-head tally per operator through wallet and host changes. Each reef serves one head, carries its trading capacity, and expires every epoch. harbor activates or renews head \(k\) only after one burn of \(3^{k-1}\) USDC. Ten heads burn 29,524 USDC per epoch, with head ten costing 19,683. Parallel activation brings no discount and cannot split a burn; another operator’s first head still burns one USDC.
